description: 臺北市木柵垃圾焚化廠營運管理及環境品質監測報告 [waste management] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 臺北市政府環境保護局木柵垃圾焚化廠. 本資料集主要提供木柵垃圾焚化廠焚化廠營運管理(包括焚化爐操作、垃圾進廠管理、飛灰與底渣清運、處理及作業環境安全衛生管理) 污染防治及監測(包括空氣污染防治、水污染防治、噪音管制、病媒防治及其他委外檢測項目)、敦親睦鄰與回饋設施及景觀維護等相關資料。. Coverage: 臺北市政府環境保護局木柵垃圾焚化廠. The portal files it under the publisher 臺北市政府環境保護局木柵垃圾焚化廠. Its tags are 生活安全及品質. It offers 1 resource(s) in json. The portal shows 2026-09-17 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
